<!--
Keep what you fill in; delete any heading you leave empty.

The reader can see the diff. What they cannot see is why. Decisions is the
section that carries the weight — without it this is a changelog.
-->

## Problem

<!--
What was broken or missing, with concrete evidence: commit hashes, the error
message, a failed run. Not "improves X".
-->

## What changes

<!--
One short entry per commit, in order, using the commit subjects, so the reader
can map this onto the history.
-->

## Decisions

<!--
The alternatives considered and why they were rejected. The judgement calls a
reviewer would otherwise have to ask about.
-->

## Verification

<!--
What proves this works — the CI job, the test, the manual run — and what is
still unproven. Saying "unverified until the tag" is legitimate; claiming a
check passed before it has is not.
-->
